text: Liquid I.V. has been part of Unilever since 2020, per McLaren's own partner page for the brand.
short: Liquid I.V. is part of Unilever.

source.name: McLaren Racing – Liquid I.V. partner page
source.quote: Liquid I.V. is America's #1 powdered hydration brand, based in Los Angeles, CA and part of Unilever since 2020.

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia – Unilever
additionalSources.quote: Unilever is listed on the London Stock Exchange with secondary listings on the Euronext Amsterdam
